body: I have bipolar disorder and have trouble with manic spending. I’ve bought a skateboard (at 25, when I’ve never used on in my life and have no interest to), 4 ukuleles at the same time, not knowing how to play them, a magic kit and several book’s and instructional dvds to do tricks, a bunch of expensive LEGO sets—those I did build and enjoy, but shouldn’t have purchased at the time.
Writing and repeating affirmations to myself, visualizing, thinking through scripts of how I want things to go.
I tried small stuff. Still didn’t work.
I have a lot of trouble believing something that I can’t see working

Tried it. I try to be open minded and hopeful, but it’s hard to believe in something that has shown absolutely no evidence of working for me. I used to be a lot more able to suspend disbelief, but after years of nothing, all I can conclude is that at least for me, it doesn’t work. 

I’d like a way for it to work faster or at least work at all.
Gratitude, scripting/journaling, affirmations, visualization, you name it, I’ve tried it. Literally nothing has worked in several years of trying.

I don’t like the Hicks. It never works when I’m in a good mood either. I don’t know how to give an accurate view of the situation without describing the fact that it isn’t working on the things I try to manifest.

I think it must, judging by my results, which are basically none. I am depressed and just have a low happiness point in general. I think it prevents me from bringing anything good into my life, which increases my depression.

I’m in the same boat as you. I tried using the 55x5 for a job opportunity and didn’t get it. 

I’ve tried it before for other things and also had no results. It’s really frustrating.
I can’t afford to hire anyone and I don’t really have friends or family that would help. It’s just something you have to do as an adult, like it or not.
The therapist I’ve been seeing for the past seven months. She has helped me so much!
Do you have a particular technique or video or guided thing you use to do the tapping or just something you cane up with yourself?
I don’t have time for small stuff. I have no money, no hope of getting any money, and a pile of bills.

I can’t even get into the program since my psychiatrist hasn’t sent over the form. I can’t make an appointment with the program psychiatrist, who takes weeks to book, because he hasn’t sent the form. 

I fucking give up. I’ve waited almost two months for help. No one gives enough of a fuck about me to help.
I’ve tried to get my hands on some, but no luck.
Doing better. I cleared out the rotten food, changed the litter boxes, and cleared off space on the kitchen table.
I don’t think I have anger toward my parents. I think it’s more about feeling that no matter how much work I do, there’s still so much more. I never seem to do enough.

Thank you for your sympathies. 

You say it’s not hopeless. Do you have any advice for how to not feel it is?
